title: Explicit Homology Representation for Finite Groups Acting on Riemann Surfaces
summary: Given a finite group $G$ acting orientably on a surface $S$ of genus $σ\geq 2$, the group $G$ acts faithfully on the homology group $H_{1}(S;\mathbb{Z})$, preserving the symplectic intersection form. The action on $S$ and the homology is determined by a \emph{generating vector}, a tuple of elements of $G$, generating $G$ and satisfying certain properties. In this note we show how to compute the homology representation, using the generating vector, when $S/G$ has genus 0 and the genus is suitably low.
